title: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer -- Scholars & Finance Professionals | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified AI & Digital Assets Engineer -- Scholars & Finance Professionals. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 10 months. Description: The Digital Assets & Islamic Finance major for structuring, validation, and product professionals to carry a Shariah-compliant asset from fatwa to deployed token. No coding required. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
